claims: Michigan defeated UConn 69-63 in the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament championship game.
The 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament championship game was on April 6, 2026.
The win was Michigan's first title since 1989.
The Michigan Wolverines won their second national title.
Elliot Cadeau led Michigan with 19 points.
The 2026 championship game was at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.
Yaxel Lendeborg scored 13 points for Michigan despite injury.
Alex Karaban scored 17 points for UConn.
Tarris Reed Jr. scored 13 points for UConn.
Tarris Reed Jr. had 14 rebounds for UConn.
The win gives Dusty May his first national title.
The win marks the first NCAA title for a Big Ten team in 26 years.
#1 UConn defeated #6 Michigan 72-69 in a November 2025 women's basketball matchup at Mohegan Sun Arena.
Michigan defeated UConn 59-0 in football on September 17, 2022, at Michigan Stadium.
